spec.description: Optimized native-column variant. SQL uses direct comparisons and stored values; no source-column type casts or sampler/IP decoding.

spec.title: Average traffic (bps)
spec.description: Native ClickHouse columns only: no type conversion, IP decoding, substring search, protocol label formatting, or sampling-rate expansion in SQL.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (sum(bytes) * 8 * 1000) / (${__to} - ${__from}) AS bps
FROM default.flows_raw
WHERE $__dateFilter(date) AND $__timeFilter(time_received_ns)
  AND (${src_ip:singlequote} = '' OR src_addr = ${src_ip:singlequote})
  AND (${dst_ip:singlequote} = '' OR dst_addr = ${dst_ip:singlequote})
  AND sampler_address = ${exporter:singlequote}
  AND (${proto:raw} = -1 OR proto = ${proto:raw})
  AND (${port:raw} = -1 OR src_port = ${port:raw} OR dst_port = ${port:raw})
  AND (${interface:raw} = -1 OR in_if = ${interface:raw} OR out_if = ${interface:raw})

FROM
(
  SELECT arrayJoin(topKWeighted(15, 10, 'counts')(dst_addr, bytes)) AS item
  FROM default.flows_raw
  WHERE $__dateFilter(date) AND $__timeFilter(time_received_ns)
  AND (${src_ip:singlequote} = '' OR src_addr = ${src_ip:singlequote})
  AND (${dst_ip:singlequote} = '' OR dst_addr = ${dst_ip:singlequote})
  AND sampler_address = ${exporter:singlequote}
  AND (${proto:raw} = -1 OR proto = ${proto:raw})
  AND (${port:raw} = -1 OR src_port = ${port:raw} OR dst_port = ${port:raw})
  AND (${interface:raw} = -1 OR in_if = ${interface:raw} OR out_if = ${interface:raw})

ORDER BY traffic_bytes DESC
LIMIT 15

spec.name: exporter
spec.label: Sampler / SNMP instance
spec.description: Uses sampler_address directly; no decoding or conversion.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT sampler_address
FROM default.flows_raw
WHERE $__dateFilter(date) AND $__timeFilter(time_received_ns)
ORDER BY sampler_address
LIMIT 500

spec.description: Numeric port. -1 disables the filter. Compared directly with src_port/dst_port.
